comment: Scripted rider conversations for tests/chat/eval.mjs. Each turn is one rider message; the eval sends them in order against a live deployment and scores the assistant's replies on properties, not exact wording. `checks` names the per-scenario assertions in eval.mjs; global assertions run on every turn regardless.

scenarios.title: Senior gives an exact age (happy path)
turns: I need a ride from San Ramon City Hall to San Ramon Regional Medical Center.
I'd like to go on August 12, 2026, leaving at 10:00 AM. One way is fine.
I'm 72 years old, I live in San Ramon, I'm not disabled, not ADA-certified, and not a veteran.

scenarios.title: Senior who will not give an age
turns: I'm a senior and I need a ride from San Ramon City Hall to San Ramon Regional Medical Center on August 12, 2026 at 10:00 AM, one way.
I'd rather not say my exact age.
No, I really don't want to give my age. What can you tell me?

scenarios.title: Rider declines every eligibility question
turns: I need a ride from Richmond City Hall to Kaiser Permanente Richmond Medical Center on August 12, 2026 at 1:00 PM, one way.
I'd prefer not to answer any personal questions about my age, disability, or veteran status.
Just tell me who might be able to take me.

scenarios.title: No provider covers both ends (DVC to San Francisco)
turns: I need a ride from Diablo Valley College to San Francisco City Hall on August 12, 2026 at 9:00 AM, one way. I'm 70, live in Pleasant Hill, not disabled, not ADA-certified, not a veteran.

scenarios.title: Unusual hour, mixing providers with and without known hours
scenarios.comment: As of 2026-07-27, 23 of 30 providers have researched service hours and 7 do not. A 5am Sunday pickup must do two things at once: name the schedule constraint for providers whose hours are known, saying which day or time would work instead, and flag the time as unconfirmed for those whose hours are not on file.
turns: I need a ride from San Ramon City Hall to San Ramon Regional Medical Center on Sunday, August 16, 2026 at 5:00 AM, one way. I'm 70, live in San Ramon, not disabled, not ADA-certified, not a veteran.

scenarios.title: Named place resolves to a different city
turns: I need a ride from my house in Antioch to DVC in Antioch.

scenarios.title: Multi-provider Richmond search (payload size)
turns: I need a ride from Richmond City Hall to Kaiser Permanente Richmond Medical Center on August 12, 2026, departing at noon, round trip returning at 3:00 PM. I'm 68, I live in Richmond, I'm not disabled, not ADA-certified, and not a veteran.

scenarios.title: One-way trip is never asked for a return time
turns: One way only: Richmond City Hall to Kaiser Permanente Richmond Medical Center, August 12, 2026 at 2:00 PM.
I'm 68, live in Richmond, not disabled, not ADA-certified, not a veteran.

scenarios.title: Follow-up about a provider from an earlier turn
turns: I need a ride from Richmond City Hall to Kaiser Permanente Richmond Medical Center on August 12, 2026 at noon, one way. I'm 68, live in Richmond, not disabled, not ADA-certified, not a veteran.
Which of those did you say I still need to check eligibility for, and why?

scenarios.title: General accessibility question, not a trip request
turns: Does BART have wheelchair access at every station?
